hypothesis: Sector-level peer earnings shock transfer (OHLCV proxy: gap>=5% + volume>=1.8x in last 5 days from same-sector peers) should predict positive 10-day forward excess returns for watchlist equity tickers, providing a genuinely new source family independent of individual-stock alpha_score, FINRA short pressure, companyfacts fundamentals, and breadth signals.
change_summary: Probe-only: ran multi-window sector-level peer earnings shock bucket probe using ohlcv_snapshot_20241002_20250422.json, ohlcv_snapshot_20250423_20251022.json, and ohlcv_snapshot_20251023_20260421.json. Computed bucket [pos] (moderate positive peer shock: score>0 but <STRONG=0.03) 10d excess vs SPY forward returns across all three canonical windows. No code was written or deployed.
nearby_prior_experiments: exp-20260603-005 (exact-industry Item 2.02 peer transfer via SEC filings — rejected)
component: scripts/peer_earnings_transfer_probe.py (observe-only, extended to all three windows)

probe_results.three_window_consistency: FAILS — pos bucket lift is positive in old_thin and mid_weak but clearly NEGATIVE in late_strong (-1.48pp). Signal direction reverses in the most recent canonical window.

calibration.surprise_note: The pos (moderate positive) bucket lifted +5.62pp in old_thin and +1.17pp in mid_weak but reversed to -1.48pp in late_strong. Likely caused by tariff-uncertainty mean-reversion in late 2025 - early 2026 where prior sector leaders sold off on earnings beats (buy the news, sell the fact). The strong_pos bucket was equally negative (-0.97pp) in late_strong.

rejection_reason: Sector-level OHLCV peer earnings shock transfer fails three-window consistency. The pos (moderate positive peer shock) bucket shows lift of +5.62pp in old_thin and +1.17pp in mid_weak but REVERSES to -1.48pp in late_strong. The signal is regime-dependent, not generalizable. Likely mechanism: in AI-cycle bull phase (old_thin), sector co-movement is strong and positive earnings shocks propagate; in tariff-uncertainty / mean-reversion regime (late_strong), same-sector earnings beats trigger profit-taking in peers.
next_retry_requires: A regime gate that reliably identifies the 'propagation-friendly' vs 'mean-reversion' market state before entry
A fundamentally new non-OHLCV information source for peer earnings quality (e.g., actual earnings surprise magnitude, not just gap/volume proxy)
Or: evidence from a third-party sector ETF performance that confirms cross-sector earnings propagation in the specific regime
anti_repeat_rule: Do not retry sector-level OHLCV peer earnings shock transfer as a candidate-pool source family without a regime gate or fundamentally richer peer earnings quality signal. The OHLCV gap/volume proxy for earnings events is too noisy and regime-dependent to be a consistent source family. Prior exact-industry Item 2.02 SEC filing tests (exp-20260603-005) also failed; this OHLCV proxy failed at the sector level for the same structural reason.

within_theme_momentum.description: Also probed within-theme excess return (ret20 minus theme-average ret20) as a candidate pool signal. Only AI and mega_cap themes have 3+ members in the OHLCV universe.
within_theme_momentum.three_window_consistency: FAILS — inconsistent direction: high_exc bucket has small positive lift in all windows but low_exc bucket (+0.72pp) BEATS high_exc (+0.42pp) in late_strong, indicating mean-reversion not momentum within themes in that window.

notes: Probe-only experiment. No code written, no backtest run. Both sector peer earnings transfer (OHLCV proxy) and within-theme momentum suffer from the same regime-dependence problem in the late_strong window.
